items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or go-live; counsel_required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy, and future affiliate/advertising use. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access but not redistribution rights; public terms restrict commercial/public use of listings, prices, and derivatives. All four launch-readiness legal tasks remain open. Technical compliance is incomplete fleet-wide: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown; operations and fleet-doctor evidence are unavailable. Exact decision: no public exposure, affiliate/advertising expansion, notification expansion, or rights outreach until owner authorizes counsel-reviewed outreach and the rights, privacy, security, accuracy, and measurement gates are evidenced. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere is not blocked solely by incomplete telemetry.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. Progress: the Woot rights packet and counsel packet are evidenced, and repository/configuration artifacts exist for data flow and privacy pages. No task is closed because authoritative permission, retention/deletion controls, GA4 settings, vendor/DPA review, and jurisdictional review remain missing. Next evidence action: assemble one dated read-only bundle containing the four task artifacts, then route the rights and jurisdictional gaps to human counsel before any owner-authorized outreach or disposition change.

Private or parked properties retain a concrete decision: keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. The next evidence action is to attach dated ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance baseline, security unknowns, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence. No publish, deploy, DNS, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or new queue admission is cleared.
